Specification: This module states a refinement relationship between two allocator specifications. It extends SchedulingAllocator, instantiates SimpleAllocator as Simple, defines SimpleAllocator as Simple!SimpleAllocator, and asserts the theorem Allocator => SimpleAllocator.
